outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample (n=141); the accompanying histograms are distributions, not averages requiring overlaid points. Scatter plots and histograms are exempt from this check.
This is a scatter/XY plot (mean ± s.d. per reporter plotted as points with error bars). Scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays under this check.
Line plots showing fitted normal/gamma density distributions of periods and amplitudes; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Box plots of CWT ridge lengths are exempt as a plot type, and individual sample points (colored circles per reporter) are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histograms depict distributions of phase differences over time (probability-normalized), analogous to histograms, which are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Polar histogram summarizing phase-difference distributions averaged by subtype; as a histogram-type visualization it is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

This is an illustrative single-example line plot (raw signal with fitted decaying sinusoid) for methodology demonstration, not an averaged summary of multiple samples, so individual points are not applicable.
Scatter plot of amplitude vs. decay rate per sample (n=117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
